title: Moldova’s national team learns its opponents for the 2026 World Championships in London
excerpt: Following the official ITTF draw, Moldova’s squad now knows its group for the World Team Table Tennis Championships 2026 in London.
body_html:
Following the official draw held under the auspices of the ITTF, the Republic of Moldova national team now knows its path through the group stage of the World Team Table Tennis Championships 2026, which will take place in London.

According to the draw, Moldova has been placed in Group 12 alongside the national teams of Poland, Chile and Tahiti. The group line-up points to a balanced contest, with opponents from different table tennis schools, each with its own tactical and stylistic character.

Moldova’s participation in the World Championships in London is an important result for national table tennis, confirming the team’s steady progress and the work put in over recent years by players, coaches and the governing bodies. Being in a group that is diverse both geographically and in strength brings real challenges as well as the chance to show the national squad’s competitive maturity on the world stage.

The coming preparation phase will be crucial, with the focus on strengthening team cohesion, adapting to the opponents’ styles and peaking in form for the top competition for national teams. ATTP will keep Moldova’s table tennis community regularly informed about how preparations are going and about the group-stage match schedule.

Based on the ITTF rankings and recent international appearances, it is provisionally expected that Poland and Chile could rely, among others, on players such as Milosz Redzimski and Samuel Kulczycki (Poland), and Gustavo Gómez and Felipe Olivares (Chile), with the final squads to be officially confirmed by the ITTF.

ATTP Moldova wishes the national team every success and calls on all table tennis fans to stand behind our players on their way to the London 2026 World Championships.
